description: Calls the AudD API (api.audd.io) as this account - music recognition, streams management, callbacks, etc. Uses the account plan quota exactly like a direct API call. For repeated or programmatic use, PREFER get_api_token and call https://api.audd.io/ directly from your own code/script - that is more efficient and reliable than routing every call through this tool; use make_api_request for one-off or interactive calls. Read get_api_docs first for endpoints and parameters. Audio must be passed by URL (e.g. params.url); binary file upload is not possible through this tool.

params.description: Request parameters as key-value strings, e.g. {"url": "https://example.com/a.mp3", "return": "spotify,apple_music"} (api_token is added automatically)

path.description: API path, default the main endpoint "/". E.g. "setCallbackUrl"

name: make_api_request

result.description: endpoint-specific result payload (object, array, or null)

title: Make an AudD API request
